'''Shatter Scar Vale''' lies north of the [[Bloodvenom Falls]] in [[Felwood]]. Shatter Scar Vale is where many of the demonic [[infernal]]s fell to [[Azeroth]] during the invasion of the [[Burning Legion]] during the [[Third War]]. Still-smoldering craters dot the vale, and [[demon]]s still wander the scarred landscape.
